item.text: {"action":"write","arguments_json":"{\"path\":\"work.py\",\"content\":\"\\\"\\\"\\\"Evaluate whether declared source dependencies changed.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n\\nimport json\\n\\n\\n_MISSING = {\\\"kind\\\": \\\"missing\\\"}\\n\\n\\ndef _canonical_json(value):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"Return the canonical JSON representation used for state comparison.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    return json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, separators=(\\\",\\\", \\\":\\\"), ensure_ascii=False)\\n\\n\\ndef evaluate(request, policy):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"Compare saved and current states for relevant declared paths.\\n\\n    Missing mapping entries are treated as ``{\\\"kind\\\": \\\"missing\\\"}``.\\n    Neither input is modified.\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    declared = request.get(\\\"declared\\\", [])\\n    saved = request.get(\\\"saved\\\", {})\\n    current = request.get(\\\"current\\\", {})\\n    ignored = set(policy.get(\\\"ignored\\\", []))\\n\\n    paths = sorted(set(declared) - ignored)\\n    changed = []\\n    missing_json = _canonical_json(_MISSING)\\n\\n    for path in paths:\\n        saved_json = _canonical_json(saved[path]) if path in saved else missing_json\\n        current_json = _canonical_json(current[path]) if path in current else missing_json\\n        if saved_json != current_json:\\n            changed.append(path)\\n\\n    return {\\\"needs_review\\\": bool(changed), \\\"changed\\\": changed}\\n\"}"}
